applies_to.reference_rule: The CPU reference must use the same algorithm, equations, operation ordering, substep boundaries, solver iteration ordering, and input snapshots as the GPU path. Different algorithms are compared using analytic fixtures and physical invariants, not frame-by-frame trajectory equality.

normalization.length_reference: median positive rest-edge length in the Physics Mesh
normalization.mass_reference: median positive dynamic Physics Vertex mass
normalization.time_reference: actual Integration Segment duration used by the compared update
normalization.contact_mass_reference: median positive dynamic Physics Vertex mass pooled across every Mesh participating in the World Contact Solver; if no positive dynamic mass exists, all Contacts are NON_RESPONSIVE_CONTACT and no impulse reference is evaluated
normalization.contact_length_reference: median positive rest-edge length pooled across every Mesh participating in the World Contact Solver
normalization.contact_impulse_reference: contact_mass_reference * contact_length_reference / actual dt_contact (dt_segment for Discrete Contact; tau for TOI prefix)

animation_trajectory_position.reference: independent CPU-double evaluation of the same Span Packet at identical normalized tau

animation_trajectory_velocity.reference: analytical derivative of the final blended, hierarchical, skinned trajectory

cloth_bend_analytic_gradient_vs_central_.step_size_policy: scale perturbation from per-mesh length_reference and avoid degenerate hinge configurations

xpbd_projected_lambda_delta_consistency.identity: lambda_next - lambda_old equals applied_delta_lambda; position correction uses that same applied delta

animation_packet_derivative.reference: central difference of independent CPU-double trajectory at interior tau; do not sample across STEP / Span discontinuities

contact_penetration_after_solve.applies_to: fixtures whose configured solver iteration and substep budget is expected to converge

candidate_completeness.small_scene_reference: broadphase candidates must contain every VT / EE pair found by exhaustive CPU reference

ccd.unresolved_candidate_policy: reject logical step; never reinterpret unresolved as no-hit

contact_projection_velocity_leakage.rule: v_pre_contact is captured after non-contact constraints and before Contact Position XPBD; Contact positional correction must not change the saved velocity used by Friction / Restitution.

contact_restitution_energy_source.policy: restitution uses relative velocity sampled before Contact Position correction
contact_restitution_energy_source.applies_to: fixtures with no external force / no incoming normal kinetic energy and restitution=0

animation_trajectory_bounds.reference: independent CPU-double interval bounds plus adversarial dense samples inside every Animation Span
animation_trajectory_bounds.unbounded_span_policy: split deterministically up to depth 8; then BLOCKED_BY_INPUT / CCDUnresolved and no commit

non_responsive_contact.diagnostic: NON_RESPONSIVE_CONTACT exactly once per canonical contact event
non_responsive_contact.threshold: epsilon_inverse_mass = 1e-12 / mass_reference_world [1/kg]; mass_reference_world is the median positive dynamic Vertex mass [kg] across participating World meshes. No positive dynamic mass means all contacts are non-responsive.

residual_definition.tangent: length(j_t - project_to_disk(j_t - v_t / W_ii, friction * (j_support + j_n)))

coupled_contact_impulse.unresolved_policy: CONTACT_IMPULSE_UNRESOLVED rejects the entire Logical Tick; never commit a non-converged impact

contact_impulse_energy.applies_to: isolated contact fixtures without external work; measure post-Impulse velocity after removing positional projection work

integration_segment_budget.overflow_policy: WORK_BUDGET_EXCEEDED preserves the Tick Reservation; never merge distinct Animation / Force / Impulse / TOI boundaries

animation_gpu_packet_time.reference: CPU-double absolute timeline mapped to Span-local normalized u and Segment-relative tau; compare GPU u_tau against an independent CPU-double evaluator at both early and large absolute World Times
animation_gpu_packet_time.residual_segment_rule: u_segment_start advances after every positive-duration Segment by dt_segment / span_duration; TOI uses tau / span_duration; at the next Animation Span boundary switch Record and initialize u_segment_start=0
animation_gpu_packet_time.precision_failure_policy: split deterministically up to depth 8; then ANIMATION_TIME_PRECISION_UNRESOLVED and no Commit
animation_gpu_packet_time.cursor_buffer_role: Mutable per-World UAV / Working State; not part of the immutable trajectory Packet
animation_gpu_packet_time.cursor_update_policy: GPU advances Cursor after each Segment; TOI retime / Retry restore Cursor from Segment Snapshot; Tick Reject discards Working Cursor without mutating committed Packet / Cursor state

profiles.mixed_mesh_pairs: include Soft Body / Soft Body, Cloth / Cloth, Soft Body / Cloth and self-collision cases

benchmark_policy.fps_acceptance: The requirement's 3-40 FPS range is an evaluation target, not a fixed guarantee for every asset profile. Report measured FPS with all quality gates and workload metadata.
benchmark_policy.gpu_timing: Use asynchronous D3D11 timestamp/disjoint queries. Separate CPU submission, GPU pass time, total physics time, Render Feedback time and frame time.
benchmark_policy.memory: Record SkinPhysics-owned allocation bytes separately from DXGI local-memory CurrentUsage and Budget.
benchmark_policy.quality_policy: Do not reduce solver quality, collision scope, substeps or iteration count silently to improve a performance result. Cloth Temporal Quality Limit is a constraint-frequency quality heuristic, not a proof of XPBD stability; its factor is recorded and calibrated separately. Contact Temporal Quality Limit is an explicit timestep cap, default 1/120 s; it is not a stiffness-derived stability proof. GPU Animation Trajectory Packet evaluation must be profiled separately from the CPU Packet preparation time. maximum_integration_segments_per_tick counts World Substep, Animation Span, Force / Impulse and dynamically added TOI segments. Exceeding the cap preserves the same Tick Reservation without coalescing boundaries. D3D11 SM5 Animation Packet uses float / uint32 only. Absolute World Time stays CPU double; GPU uses Span-local normalized u and Segment-relative tau. Verify fixed Record strides (64 / 208 / 48 / 128 bytes) and monotonic u_segment_start across Substep / Force / Impulse / TOI Segment boundaries. Every Animation Span Record must own explicit Track / Channel / Blend / Collider Buffer Ranges; Blend Source / Target Track indices are Span-relative and range-checked. Each Channel Record carries Node Role and Inverse Bind Static Record Index; invalid references, omitted Mesh Node or omitted Joint Ancestor records fail the animation packet ABI gate. Immutable Animation Trajectory Packet Records are read-only. Per-World animation_span_cursor_gpu_record (16 bytes) is mutable working state, snapshot / rollback protected, and checked separately from Packet ABI. Animation Trajectory Packet is immutable and read-only. Mutable per-World Span Cursor is a separate 16-byte UAV record, included in Segment Snapshot / rollback and validated for zero Packet mutations.

threshold_changes_require: rerun of all analytical, numerical, physical and integration tests
